# Physiotherapy Treatment

> > Free online physiotherapy education resource providing evidence-based treatment protocols, exercise therapy programs, and rehabilitation guides for orthopedic, neurological, and sports-related conditions.

The site offers comprehensive physiotherapy treatment information spanning musculoskeletal disorders, neurological rehabilitation, pediatric conditions, and therapeutic exercise techniques. Content includes detailed protocols for conditions from stroke recovery to sports injuries, featuring specialized techniques like PNF (Proprioceptive Neuromuscular Facilitation) and assessment methods such as Q-angle measurement.

## Neurological Rehabilitation

- [Stroke Physical Therapy](https://www.physiotherapy-treatment.com/stroke-physical-therapy.html): Comprehensive stroke rehab program from acute care to community stage
- [Elderly Falls](https://www.physiotherapy-treatment.com/elderly-falls.html): Fall prevention guide covering risk assessment and exercise interventions

## Spinal Conditions & Treatment

- [Cervical Osteoarthritis](https://www.physiotherapy-treatment.com/Cervical-Osteoarthritis.html): Cervical spondylosis treatment for pain relief and nerve injury prevention
- [Lumbar Spondylosis](https://www.physiotherapy-treatment.com/lumbar-spondylosis.html): Lower back degenerative disc disease and facet joint changes treatment
- [Scoliosis Exercises](https://www.physiotherapy-treatment.com/scoliosis-exercises.html): Spinal deformity exercises using Klapp and Risser techniques

## Hip & Groin Injuries

- [Greater Trochanteric Bursitis](https://www.physiotherapy-treatment.com/greater-trochanteric-bursitis.html): Lateral hip pain diagnosis using Patrick's test and FABER assessment
- [Iliopectineal Bursitis](https://www.physiotherapy-treatment.com/iliopectineal-bursitis.html): Iliopsoas bursa inflammation affecting hip flexors in athletes
- [Snapping Hip Syndrome](https://www.physiotherapy-treatment.com/snapping-hip-syndrome.html): Coxa saltans types, causes, and iliopsoas/ITB involvement in dancers
- [Osteitis Pubis](https://www.physiotherapy-treatment.com/osteitis-pubis.html): Pubic symphysitis in athletes: erosion, healing, and groin pain management

## Therapeutic Techniques & Exercise Programs

- [PNF Techniques](https://www.physiotherapy-treatment.com/pnf-techniques.html): Proprioceptive Neuromuscular Facilitation by Kabat, Knott, and Voss
- [Hydrotherapy Exercises](https://www.physiotherapy-treatment.com/hydrotherapy-exercises.html): Aquatic therapy exercises using water buoyancy for pain-free movement
- [Medicine Ball Workouts](https://www.physiotherapy-treatment.com/medicine-ball-workouts.html): Core, upper and lower body medicine ball exercises with video guides
- [Best Weight Loss Exercises](https://www.physiotherapy-treatment.com/best-weight-loss-exercises.html): 20 equipment-free exercises for weight loss and full-body fat reduction

## Lower Extremity Conditions

- [Treatment For Plantar Fasciitis](https://www.physiotherapy-treatment.com/treatment-for-plantar-fasciitis.html): Heel pain treatment with stretching, massage, and footwear modifications
- [Q angle](https://www.physiotherapy-treatment.com/Q-angle.html): Quadriceps angle measurement for patellofemoral disorder assessment
- [Toddler Knock Knee](https://www.physiotherapy-treatment.com/toddler-knock-knee.html): Q&A on pediatric genu valgum diagnosis and Robert Jones heels treatment

## Specialized Conditions & Alternative Therapies

- [myositis ossificans](https://www.physiotherapy-treatment.com/myositis-ossificans.html): Muscle ossification types, pathology, symptoms and treatment protocols
- [Can EFT Help With Fibromyalgia?](https://www.physiotherapy-treatment.com/can-eft-help-with-fibromyalgia.html): Emotional Freedom Technique (EFT) effectiveness for fibromyalgia pain
